id: title:danielcarletti:stop re reading the last cdc buffer file every run

review.reason: Adds structured metadata (ETags, file positions) to warehouse ingestion proofs, supporting recovery and billing correctness.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual PostHog adoption or realized benefit. Tier 2 assigned because the implementation and relevant checks are visible, but tier 3 requires broader systemic demonstration not established here.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single conservative group. No score assigned. No tier assigned. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field `tail` to the `ListingProof` class, storing a mapping of file names to ETags, and updates the return type of `read_completed_listing_proof` and `completed_listing_proof` to return this new object instead of just a timestamp. This changes the API and the stored state.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a more robust consumption check, potentially allowing PostHog to distinguish between a file that was read and a file that was not, based on the ETag. This could help prevent data loss or corruption during CDC ingestion.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field `etag` to the `_BufferFile` class, and a helper function `_listing_tail` to extract the tail of the buffer. This could support the new consumption check.

observations.behavior: Adds a 'tail' parameter to the ListingProof model and its usage, including ETag and file position tracking.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to record not just the timestamp of a completed listing, but also the highest file position and associated ETags, supporting recovery and billing correctness.

observations.behavior: Updates the dispatch call to pass a proof object instead of a timestamp, and the assertion checks the returned ListingProof object.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the warehouse ingestion workflow to rely on structured proof objects rather than raw timestamps, supporting recovery and billing correctness.

observations.behavior: Adds ETag and file position tracking to the S3 listing mock, including conditional delete and cache invalidation.
